claim: Discord Sucks: Subreddit for frustrated discord users.
summary: If you are frustrated with Discord and have had enough, then this is the group for you. If you just need some help with Discord and you do not want to go to /r/discordapp, then this group is also for you. Finally, if you just want an honest answer, that is not corporately influenced, this can also be a place for you. If you want to write about how you are love in Discord, then you are mistaken ...
